evaluation_notes: Synthetic fixture validating the harness, not provider accuracy. Video generated by benchmarks/fixtures/generate.py: 7s black 320x240@15fps, the word FLASH burned in for 0.3s starting at t=1,2,3,4,5,6s. Expected timestamps are the flash midpoints (start + 0.15s) annotated from the generation parameters, never from a model. Tolerance is 0.5s, not the usual 1.0s: flashes are ~1s apart, so a 1.0s window would blur adjacent events together. sha256 of the author's fixture: 67f6a0625ac41668ac2f298e99dbb557b0468607a0c3030dbeaf71e4322e1281 (regenerate locally; videos are gitignored).
instructions: Report each brief visible text flash on screen. For each flash, return its type ("flash") and the timestamp in seconds when it appears.
known_ambiguities: Each flash lasts 0.3s (about 4-5 frames at 15fps); a sparse frame sampler can miss a flash entirely, which scores as a miss.
Flash onset within the 0.3s window is frame-quantized; the midpoint is the least-committal annotation.
